title: Phase 55L converts eight research directions into implementation trails
summary: Added an eight-record federal implementation-evidence collection, seven Tier 1 source profiles, seven new In Review signals, one repaired USAspending signal, one In Review briefing, and an expanded dependency map spanning named awards, obligations, contracts, a facility loan, a scheduled field trial, a delivered nuclear-fuel milestone, transmission finance, and standards artifacts.
evidence_note: Every record is assigned the strongest stage its official source supports. Award values, obligations, scheduled trials, delivered material, and standards artifacts remain explicitly separate from completed facilities, accepted systems, operation, and scale.
